items.title: Bob Havens interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I auditioned with another piano player in town who had an orchestra... he hired me to play in his orchestra. As a matter of fact you have his first name also, Monk.

ctx.x: We are filming today in Chautauqua, New York for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and my guest today is Bob Havens, trombonist. Welcome.
Well, it’s a pleasure to be here, Monk.
Is it a bit of a challenge to fit this in during this weekend? They have you working pretty hard.
